comments.content: I have heard this from deputy’s for years and years

Ask them about the female deputy that was involved in a domestic incident with her significant other in Mississippi and fled from law enforcement as they attempted to investigate the incident. She was allowed to keep her job.

Or what about the supervisor who is known for being a compulsive liar, and has been that way for years. Hence, his nickname. He recently lied about a subordinate deputy and made some serious accusations against him. Fortunately, that deputy was able to prove his innocence, but that supervisor was allowed to keep his rank. Pays to be one of the good ole boys.

Yep. That’s right. What about the deputy who told everyone he was a Christian, and when he spoke out on topics that were part of his Christian and moral belief he got blasted for standing up for himself when another person said he was insulting them. That deputy had every right to say what his belief was, but because he wasn’t a social butterfly in the garden with admin, he got fucked. Seems kinda backwards on how they punished him but not the other deputy who expressed his personal views.
Feds are your only hope

Didn't the same supervisor who got in trouble years ago for sleeping with a subordinate recently have a little incident at the FloraBama where he performed a sexual act with a woman in public? Then the police were later called to his home for a domestic incident he was involved in? Some people don't learn their lesson. But apparently that doesn't matter to BCSO, because they'll sweep it under the rug for you.
What the hell is going on here?

How does any of this stuff even make sense? I’m a citizen and would like to know what’s going on. These comments and story line is making it sound as if the BCSO is being run by the circus clowns! What else is going on that people don’t know? Is there not any accountability to the leadership?

You are exactly right. There is no accountability for the guys at the top. Mack and Lowery need to go! Under their administration you can be a drunk, a liar, have affairs, have mental problems, be involved in questionable conduct while off-duty, and so on and keep your job, rank, or even progress within the department. The citizens of Baldwin County deserve better. Not a Sheriff who portrays himself one way publicly while doing the exact opposite privately.
I am dying to know which news reporter our Chief Deputy Anthony Lowery is…was having an affair with? Every time I watch the news now I am like is that her or is it that one ?

It so bizarre how Andre Reid stood up in a BCSO supervisor leadership conference and preached how much integrity there is or he has, and how the supervisors did a great job and had to “make some hard decisions, but “thank you” for holding the line and making the right decisions and he is proud of them. But then, the entire time he was the biggest bullshitter in the room because he was doing unethical things. And the whole time Anthony Lowry was singing his praises. But he gets caught and he doesn’t even get demoted!!! He should have been fired!!!

There needs to be a unified effort by deputies to remove Mack,and Lowery and make sure their replacements have nothing to do with the good ole boy club Mack is running. He should be investigated for the wrongful conviction of Murray Lawrence Jr.

I wish they could have a united front and replace them with people out of the good ole boy club. Sadly, they have moved a majority of people up the ranks to keep it a good ole boys club. They do on occasion promote "non" club members to keep peace, and to "show" how equal and fair they are, however we all know the truth. Even when they do hold club members accountable it is just for show! For "example", after SHORT brief moment the stripe/position being taken away it is returned, and they are moved out of warrants back into authority with their stripe back, then shortly after that they even receive a PROMOTION, oh what a great message that sends! It is especially a great message when the time the stripe is given back coincides with another office affair of a married deputy was being swept under a rug... So, was the stripe truly earned back, or was the good ole boy club card played?

Here is another example of unbalanced and unequal punishment: A certain sergeant over. Patrol shift got into an auto accident. He was given time off, demoted, and then moved to an entirely different division. Whereas Andre was only moved, and his act in question brought a division among some of the coworkers and opened the door for sexual harassment claims. The insiders hit an infield home run on that one.

It’s clear as day who is in “the club” around here. Maybe Mack and Lowery will one day invite me to join their rotary club in Robertsdale with them and then Just MAYBE I get a fair shot of promotion or decent assignments. Because apparently experience, training, time in and a clean record with no affairs doesn’t count here at BCSO!

Another deputy wrecked 3 vehicles in a few short months. They made him start driving his own vehicle back and forth after he was moved to another division. He eventually was allowed another patrol car.
One deputy got caught having an affair with an female employee, and he nor she got demoted.

Years ago there was an investigator at BCSO who was sleeping with a female employee. It's actually one of the same females that Andre Reid used to mess around with. When that investigators wife found out, they almost got a divorce over it. That female and the investigator got to keep their jobs. They moved him to patrol and he couldn't handle it, so they moved him again to a gravy day shift position. He even got to keep his job after making some other big mistakes, like signing felony arrest warrants on an innocent man. He isn't there anymore because he left for some other reasons. He was liked by some higher ups and they protected him as much as possible.

There is no consistency at BCSO.

If you work for the BCSO and you truly believe that there is nothing wrong, or that there is no place for true moral values within the department, YOU ARE PART OF THE PROBLEM.

Having morals, ethics, or work values that align with what the founding fathers based the constitution on isn’t invalid anymore just because there is a woke agenda that is being pushed by some of the leaders within the BCSO. And if you believe that the department is better off with some deputies gone, or others moved simply because you disagree with their standard of keeping people accountable, YOU ARE ALSO PART OF THE PROBLEM.
A few years ago Steve Arthur was seeing someone on the side as well.

BCSO has been bitten by the woke bug. Hoss Mack is ultimately to blame. It may not look horrible yet, but give it some time. If new leadership doesn't come along and correct what Mack has done, it will become extremely evident.

I’m wondering how long it will be before Hoss Mack and Anthony Lowry moves Andre back into another role where he can clean up his reputation and publicly become a good ole boy again?? HE SHOULD HAVE BEEN FIRED. Hoss should step down, and Anthony Lowry should be let go for promoting his own agenda laden tyrannical behavior that is decisive and goes against good sound leadership characteristics.

When Hoss Mack’s secretary and one of the senior Lt / Captain  whatever he was at the time were caught having an affair, he was married to a senior communications officer for BCSO. They carried it on the affair for a long time until his wife caught them. There certainly was a lot of tension between all of them that caused hostile work environment and animosity. Nothing happened to them either. Was it ok? Because that is the impression that’s being given. You can have an affair, and nothing will happen. You can conceal or hide evidence. Nothing will happen. You can lie on the witness stand. Nothing will happen. You can wreck cars. Nothing will happen. You can be arrested for a felony. Nothing will happen. You can beat your girlfriend. Sometimes you might get fired or you may not. You can be drunk driving a county vehicle. Sometimes you will get fired, sometimes not. You can get caught being drunk and have a deputy take you home, and not get in trouble. But you punch a deputy who was berating someone and calling names, and you get fired. Or have a supervisor curse you and you stand up for yourself and you get fired.

Whitney Scapecchi has the golden ticket for Jon Gray. 
We’re all here for it to come out! 😘
Imagine me just minding my own business, doing some light reading and then running across my name 🤣
